subject: Greenlight to Issue Offer — Sam Walker (L4 Platform Eng)
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Elaine Hayes <elaine.hayes@talentpartners.com>, Sam Walker <sam.walker@quantlytics.ai>
Date: Sun, 30 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Greenlight to Issue Offer — Sam Walker (L4 Platform Eng)

Team —

Following the onsite loop, recruiting sent over a proposed package for Sam Walker (L4, Platform). Summary in the attached comp_matrix; key points below: 

- Base: $165,000
- Target bonus: 12% (annual cash bonus)
- Equity: 30,000 RSUs vesting over 4 years (25/25/25/25 cliff schedule)
- One-time sign-on: $12,000 (prorated if start after 30 days)

Sam is asking for confirmation on the base and whether we can move RSUs to 35k. He also requests flexibility on the start date (late October).

Can I get approvals to issue the official offer (use standard L4 template)? If anything above needs dialing back, flag it. Recruiting would like an ETA to send by EOD tomorrow.

Thanks —
Karthik
Director, Platform Engineering
Redwood Inference

Attachments: comp_matrix_L4_platform.csv

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 30 Aug 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Greenlight to Issue Offer — Sam Walker (L4 Platform Eng)

Karthik —

Thanks for the summary. Overall the package looks reasonable given market comps for platform L4 in the region, but two requests: 

1) Keep base at $165k (already acceptable).
2) Hold RSUs at 30k rather than 35k; we should reserve the stretch for L5 or strong counter offers.

Sign-on is fine at $12k given relocation / transition risk. If recruiting pushes back on RSUs, offer to include an extra 3 months of time off (floating) instead of equity top-up.

Approve to issue the offer with base $165k, 12% bonus, 30k RSUs, $12k sign-on. Please attach the standard L4 offer letter and mark candidate as "standard comp" in the HR tracker.

Laura
VP, Engineering

---
